args.title: Fix README: replace nonexistent "npm run serve" with "npm start"
args.body:
File: README.md

In the "Running locally" section, step 5 tells readers to run `npm run build` followed by `npm run serve`. There is no `serve` script in package.json (the available scripts are start, build, test and lint), so following these instructions fails with "Missing script: serve".

Update step 5 to:

```bash
npm run build
npm start
```

This matches the actual scripts defined in package.json and resolves the error reported by new contributors following the README.
